why: Check: two consecutive entries styled with the same named background color both render that color; key changes say later lookups return the whole cache table.
Says the scene render returns before painting scrollbars when selection rendering is on, and checks that scrollbars still appear (including a zoom check with selected elements and scrollbars).
Checks the rotation handle appears and rotates, and notes about 16 px above, but no check at a zoom other than 100% for the handle distance.
Many grouping checks but none checks layer order of the new group versus non-grouped elements after grouping.
Check: moving a point and pressing undo reverts exactly that move; also undo steps back through point changes after leaving edit mode.
The multi-element selection drag check is not a grouped-element drag; no check starts a drag on an element in a group.
Only checks embed renders with default props and a click on a visible Live collaboration button doing nothing; never checks the button is hidden when no handler is supplied.
Check: opening a shareable link on a page where the drawing area sits below a banner/header opens the drawing centered within the visible area, plus reload far-from-origin drawing centered.
No check edits non-empty text of an arrow-bound text/container and confirms the binding remains; only the empty-text deletion cleanup is checked.
Group checks are about grouping a labeled shape or dragging a group with an existing label; none adds bound text to a container already in a group.
Popup centered above element checks (zoom/pan) but no offset canvas / embedded placement.
Check: control appears when selecting the shape with bound text together with its bound text (mixed selection); empty selection not checked, so rests on the mixed half.
Save-back checks exist but only for files dropped onto the canvas, not the file-picker open path that broke; picker check only verifies the drawing loads.
